<!doctype html>
<!--
  Accordion FAQ Interaction, rebuilt from the clip by Damir Sokolovsky (@heydamir)
  Source: https://x.com/heydamir/status/2111801972152225896

  Interactive: click a row to open it (its key presses and the chord sounds), hover and click the keys and the bass
  buttons, press on the instrument and drag down to pull the bellows or up to squeeze them, release and it springs.
  With ?demo=1 in the URL the page instead replays the clip's own sequence on the clip's timeline, as CSS animations
  started at load, so a checker can seek it:
    0.00-0.37  closed: rows 11 px at a 13 px pitch, text hidden
    0.37-0.73  rows open top to bottom, 50 ms apart, 160 ms each with a 6% overshoot; rows 58 px at a 65 px pitch
    2.05-2.33  pulled: bottom edge down 120 px (gaps +25, top +8, bottom +11), top edge fixed; held to 2.50
    2.50-2.82  released: snaps past rest to 35%, then 1.7 at 3.00, 0.99 at 3.23, 1.05 at 3.40, rest by 3.60
    3.80-4.05  row 3 opens, 32 px; row 2 at 4.45-4.65; row 4 at 5.25-5.40; chord chip 5.40-6.60
    9.15-9.35  row 4 closes; row 3 at 9.60-9.80; row 2 at 10.05-10.27
   13.23-13.50 pulled again to 2.1, held to 13.83; 13.83-14.20 squeezed shut, held to 14.80; 14.80-15.03 reopens to 1.22
  Two kinds of motion. The intro and a row opening change layout: the page is one column centred in the viewport, so
  the title moves up by half of whatever the instrument grows. Pulls and squeezes are transforms with the top edge
  pinned: nothing else on the page moves. --b is the bellows (0 closed, 1 rest, 2 pulled), --i each row's share of
  the intro, --o a row's open state, --anc 1 while the bellows are in transform mode.
  The red marble is two small patches of veined texture sampled from the clip's rest frame (x 362-520 and 915-1078,
  y 753-859, where nothing sits on it) stretched under each block; rims, caps, keys, buttons, folds and strap are drawn.
-->

  box-shadow: inset 0 calc(1.5 * var(--u)) 0 rgba(255, 190, 200, .55), inset 0 0 0 calc(1 * var(--u)) rgba(90, 0, 14, .5), inset 0 calc(-2 * var(--u)) calc(4 * var(--u)) rgba(40, 0, 6, .35);

.cap.bl { left: calc(-2 * var(--u)); bottom: calc(-2 * var(--u)); border-radius: calc(2 * var(--u)) calc(2 * var(--u)) calc(2 * var(--u)) calc(8 * var(--u)); transform: scaleY(-1); }
.cap.br { right: calc(-2 * var(--u)); bottom: calc(-2 * var(--u)); border-radius: calc(2 * var(--u)) calc(2 * var(--u)) calc(8 * var(--u)) calc(2 * var(--u)); transform: scale(-1); }
.top { z-index: 0; height: calc(133 * var(--u)); filter: drop-shadow(0 calc(10 * var(--u)) calc(14 * var(--u)) rgba(80, 66, 50, .16)); }

  content: ""; position: absolute; z-index: -1; left: calc(21 * var(--u)); right: calc(22 * var(--u)); top: 100%; height: calc(40 * var(--u));
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #bda0a6 0, #ddd3d1 calc(1 * var(--u)), #8f8886 calc(2 * var(--u)), #3d3735 calc(3 * var(--u)), #5a534c calc(7 * var(--u)), #7e756e calc(15 * var(--u)), #8a827b 100%);
}

  filter: drop-shadow(0 calc(22 * var(--u)) calc(22 * var(--u)) rgba(80, 66, 50, .26));
  transform: translateY(calc((120 * var(--pull) - 257 * (1 - var(--open))) * var(--anc) * var(--u)));
}

/* keyboard: black frame with a hairline outside it, warm ivory keys shaded under the frame, black keys hanging on
   thin stems down to the frame's bottom edge, each throwing a soft shadow on its neighbours */
.kb {
  position: absolute; left: calc(31 * var(--u)); top: calc(10 * var(--u)); width: calc(708 * var(--u)); height: calc(116 * var(--u));
  box-sizing: border-box; border: solid #0e0c0a; border-width: calc(3 * var(--u)) calc(5 * var(--u)) calc(4 * var(--u)) calc(4 * var(--u));
  background: #0e0c0a; border-radius: calc(9 * var(--u)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 calc(1 * var(--u)) rgba(255, 255, 255, .5);
  display: flex; gap: calc(1 * var(--u));
}
.w {
  flex: 1; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 0 0 calc(3 * var(--u)) calc(3 * var(--u));
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #cfcdc4 0%, #e9e3d8 5%, #ede8df 28%, #e2dfdc 42%, #e4e1e2 84%, #edebec 97%, #fbfafd 100%);
  transition: filter .12s;
}
.w:hover { filter: brightness(.96); }
.w.down, .w:active { filter: brightness(.9) sepia(.2); }
.b {
  position: absolute; top: calc(31 * var(--u)); width: calc(29 * var(--u)); height: calc(77 * var(--u)); cursor: pointer; z-index: 1;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #2a2624 0%, #141315 9%, #0d0d0e 30%, #1b1b1e 65%, #2e2e33 100%);
  border-radius: calc(5 * var(--u)) calc(5 * var(--u)) calc(2 * var(--u)) calc(2 * var(--u));
  box-shadow: 0 0 calc(10 * var(--u)) calc(3 * var(--u)) rgba(0, 0, 0, .2), inset calc(1 * var(--u)) 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, .07), inset calc(-1 * var(--u)) 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, .4);
  transition: filter .12s;
}
.b:hover { filter: brightness(1.3); }
.b.down, .b:active { filter: brightness(1.5); }
.b::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 50%; top: calc(-31 * var(--u)); width: calc(2 * var(--u)); height: calc(31 * var(--u)); margin-left: calc(-1 * var(--u)); background: #2b261f; }

/* the bellows. Layout: each row is 10 + 47 * --i tall, plus 32 * --o when open, with a 7 px gap. Transform mode
   (--anc 1): a pull slides each row down by its share of the stretch, a squeeze slides it up and cuts its bottom,
   so the page around it never reflows. The dark gap and the pleated fabric sit under each row, revealed as it moves. */
.mid { position: relative; margin: calc(7 * var(--u)) calc(22 * var(--u)) calc(2 * var(--u)) calc(21 * var(--u)); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: calc(2 * var(--u)); }
.row {
  position: relative; cursor: pointer; margin-bottom: calc(5 * var(--i) * var(--u));           /* gap 2 closed, 7 at rest */
  --m: min(var(--open), var(--i)); --mix: calc(var(--m) * 100%);                                        /* how much of the dark inside shows */
  --g0: color-mix(in srgb, #3b3a36 var(--mix), #c3c1be); --g1: color-mix(in srgb, #5a514c var(--mix), #c3c1be);
  --g2: color-mix(in srgb, #3b3632 var(--mix), #c3c1be); --g3: color-mix(in srgb, #6e6760 var(--mix), #d0cecb);
  --cut: calc(47 * (1 - var(--open)) * var(--anc));                               /* px taken off the bottom by a squeeze */
  --h: calc(10 + 47 * var(--i) + 32 * var(--o) - var(--cut));                     /* visible height */
  --fh: calc(var(--h) + 2 + 5 * var(--i) + (25.25 * var(--pull) - 5 * (1 - var(--open))) * var(--anc)); /* fold height: row plus gap */
  clip-path: inset(0 calc(-44 * var(--u)) calc((var(--cut) - 40) * var(--u)) calc(-44 * var(--u)));
  transform: translateY(calc(((8 + var(--k) * 25.25) * var(--pull) - var(--k) * 52 * (1 - var(--open))) * var(--anc) * var(--u)));
  transition: --o .25s cubic-bezier(.2, .8, .2, 1);
}
.row::before { /* the gap below the row: 14 px tucked under the face for its corners, then the bellows' brown inside, darkest at the crease */
  content: ""; position: absolute; z-index: -1; left: 0; right: 0; top: calc((var(--h) - 14) * var(--u));
  height: calc((14 + 2 + 5 * var(--i) + (25.25 * var(--pull) - 5 * (1 - var(--open))) * var(--anc)) * var(--u));
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--g0) 0, var(--g0) calc(14 * var(--u)), var(--g1) calc(15 * var(--u)), var(--g2) calc(50% + 7 * var(--u)), var(--g3) calc(100% - 1.5 * var(--u)), #e5e1de 100%);
}
.face {
  position: relative; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 0 calc(22 * var(--u)); border-radius: calc(11 * var(--u));
  border: calc(1 * var(--u)) solid #d6d5d1; border-bottom-color: #a6a4a0;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fdfdfd 0%, #fbfbfa 35%, #f5f6f4 100%);

}

  font-weight: 600; font-size: calc(17 * var(--u)); letter-spacing: calc(-0.2 * var(--u));
  opacity: calc((var(--open) * var(--i) - 0.35) / 0.65);

.ic::before, .ic::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; top: calc(6 * var(--u)); width: 100%; height: calc(2 * var(--u)); background: #1c1a17; border-radius: calc(1 * var(--u)); }

build.hand: two passes by hand from the clip's frames: edge tracks at 60 fps for the motion, then zoomed crops for materials and layout

1yi26a-accordion-faq-interaction.hint: Click a row to open it. Play the keys. Press on the body and drag down to pull the bellows, up to squeeze them, then let go.
1yi26a-accordion-faq-interaction.pattern:
**Keyframes hide the choreography.** A still is a moment when nothing moves, so matching every still proves nothing about the motion between them. Trace an edge per frame (the red body's top and bottom here) and the timeline reads straight off it: which parts move, in what order, how far, and whether the curve is a snap (ease-out), a settle (ease-in-out) or a cascade (one element after another). Build the timeline from those numbers first and the stills fall into place.

**Two kinds of motion, read from the title.** Track something that should not move. The title drops 131 px when the rows are shut on load and 16 px per opened row, but 2 px on a pull: the page is one column centred in the viewport, so the intro and the row openings are layout (real height), while pulls and squeezes are transforms with the top edge pinned. Build it the same way: heights for what reflows, translateY plus a clip-path cut for what does not, and one 0/1 property that says which mode the bellows are in. The side-by-side with the heading in it catches this; a crop of the instrument alone never would.

**One bellows value.** A single --b (0 closed, 1 rest, 2 pulled) drives row offset, cut, gap colour and fold size, so every part of the instrument breathes together, in the demo timeline and under the pointer alike.
